description_en: Creates a Managed Service for Prometheus instance
kebab_example: aliyun arms create-prometheus-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-type remote-write --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrometheusInstance

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values: 
remote-write: Prometheus for Remote Write.
ecs (no longer supported): Prometheus for ECS.
global-view: Prometheus for GlobalView.
aliyun-cs (no longer supported): Prometheus for Container Service.
cloud-product (no longer supported): Prometheus for Cloud Service.
cloud-monitor (no longer supported): Prometheus for Hybrid Cloud Monitoring.
flink (no longer supported): Prometheus for Flink
parameters.help_zh:
类型有： 
remote-write：Prometheus for Remote Write
ecs（不再支持）：Prometheus for ECS
global-view：Prometheus for GlobalView
aliyun-cs（不再支持）：Prometheus for 容器服务
cloud-product（不再支持）：Prometheus for 云服务
cloud-monitor（不再支持）：Prometheus for 企业云监控
flink（不再支持）: Prometheus for Flink
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster
parameters.help_zh: 用户专有网络VPC。当clusterType为ecs或者aliyun-cs的托管版ask容器集群时，需要传此参数
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster
parameters.help_zh: 用户专有网络交换机VSwitch。当clusterType为ecs或者aliyun-cs的托管版ask容器集群时，需要传此参数
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The Network Security group ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to ecs or aliyun-cs for a managed ASK cluster
parameters.help_zh: 用户专有网络安全组SecurityGroup。当clusterType为ecs或者aliyun-cs的托管版ask容器集群时，需要传此参数
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The Container Service cluster ID. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to aliyun-cs
parameters.help_zh: 用户容器服务集群ID。当clusterType为aliyun-cs时，需要传此参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cluster to create. This parameter is required when ClusterType is set to remote-write, ecs, or global-view.

For ecs instances, the ClusterName must follow the format "name-vpc-id", and the name part cannot exceed 24 characters. Example: "mytest1-vpc-xxxxxxxxxxx"
parameters.help_zh:
用户新建集群的名称。当clusterType为remote-write、ecs、global-view时，需要传此参数。

若是ecs类型实例，ClusterName的命名规则为“name-vpc-id”，且name部分的长度不允许超过24个字符，例如“mytest1-vpc-xxxxxxxxxxx”
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of sub-instances for the GlobalView instance
parameters.name: sub_clusters_json

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether all sub-instances must pass validation before the GlobalView instance is created. Default value: false, which indicates that partial success is allowed
parameters.help_zh: 创建GlobalView时，是否要求所有子实例都校验成功时，才创建GlobalView实例。默认是false，即可以部分成功
parameters.name: all_sub_clusters_success

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bound Grafana workspace. Set this parameter to "free" when you use the shared Grafana edition
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的Grafana工作区ID。使用共享版Grafana时，值为“free”
parameters.name: grafana_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data storage duration, in days
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: The number of days to automatically archive data after the storage period expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. A value of 0 indicates that data is not archived
parameters.help_zh: 存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数（可选值：60、90、180、365）。0表示不归档保存
parameters.name: archive_duration

parameters.help_en:
The Billable methods. Valid values:
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go based on the number of reported metrics.
POSTPAY_GB: pay-as-you-go based on the volume of written metrics.
Empty: uses the default billing method configured by the user. If no default is configured, the system defaults to billing based on the number of reported metrics
parameters.help_zh:
计费方式：
POSTPAY：按指标上报量后付费。
POSTPAY_GB：按指标写入量后付费。
空：则使用用户的默认计费方式配置。若用户未配置默认值，则系统默认是按指标上报量计费
parameters.name: payment_type

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2XX: success.
3XX: redirection.
4XX: request error.
5XX: server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态码：

`2XX`：成功
`3XX`：重定向
`4XX`：请求错误
`5XX`：服务器错误

Data.description_en:
The instance ID returned after the instance is created.

For aliyun-cs instances, the Prometheus instance ID is the Container Service cluster ID.

For ecs instances, the Prometheus instance ID is the VPC ID
Data.description_zh:
新建实例成功后的实例ID。

如果是aliyun-cs实例，则Prometheus实例ID就是CS的集群ID。

如果是ecs实例，则Prometheus实例ID就是VPCID
